items.description: કન્નૌજમાં લખનઉ-આગ્રા એક્સપ્રેસ-વે પર સ્કૂલ બસને ટ્રકે પાછળથી ટક્કર મારી દીધી. અકસ્માતમાં 4 બાળકોનાં મોત થયા છે. 25 લોકો ઈજાગ્રસ્ત છે. બસમાં 50 બાળકો સહિત 58 લોકો સવાર હતા. બાળકો આગ્રામાં પિકનિક મનાવીને કૌશાંબી પરત ફરી રહ્યા હતા. એસપી વિનોદ કુમારે જણાવ્યું- બસ કૌશાંબીની ઓરિએન્ટલ પબ્લિક સ્કૂલની છે. તે રાત્રે 12 વાગ્યે આગ્રાથી રવાના થઈ હતી. મંગળવારે સવારે 6 વાગ્યે બાળકોને ટોયલેટ જવા માટે બસ એક્સપ્રેસ-વે પર ઊભી રાખવામાં આવી હતી. ત્યારે પાછળથી પુરપાટ ઝડપે આવી રહેલા ટ્રકે સ્કૂલ બસને ટક્કર મારી દીધી.…

items.title: Jury awards nearly $8m after doctors allegedly miss lung cancer on breast MRI
items.author: TOI WORLD DESK
items.description: An Oregon jury awarded nearly $8 million to the estate of Wendi K. Lui and her husband after finding a radiology group and its hospital partner liable for missing a lung mass on her 2019 breast MRI. The cancer was detected during a scan in 2020, by which time it had spread to her lymph nodes. Lui died of metastatic lung cancer in 2023, aged 51. Her husband rejected settlement offers and pursued a trial to bring attention to the case.

items.title: NIA court frees 4 held for 2020 Srinagar terror attack that killed 2 soldiers
items.author: NASEER GANAI
items.description: A special NIA court ruled that four men were not guilty of aiding terrorists in the 2020 attack. The prosecution could not establish any direct link between the men and the terrorists involved in the incident. Although two Army soldiers were killed, the evidence presented was circumstantial and insufficient. The court emphasized the necessity of legal proof despite the crime's severity and implications.

items.description: The family of nine-year-old King Sha'Mar Overton has filed a $100 million wrongful-death lawsuit against Virginia summer camp SwimRVA after he drowned on his first day at the facility. items.title: Nvidia shares jump over 30%, log biggest single-day gain since 2003 as CEO Huang returns
items.author: TRISHA MAHAJAN
items.description: Nvidia's shares increased significantly after Jensen Huang returned as CEO, leading to a rise in AI stocks. The S&P 500 and the Nasdaq Composite saw their largest single-day gains since April 2025. Many other technology and semiconductor companies, including Amazon and Oracle, also experienced stock price increases. This stock market rally followed a previous week of losses and investor concerns surrounding AI investments.

items.author: TOI WORLD DESK
items.description: Cynthia Zalewski inherited her mother's home but faced foreclosure after missing payments during the pandemic. The sheriff's deed erroneously stated she had six months instead of twelve to redeem the property. The Michigan Court of Appeals recognized this error as a significant irregularity in the foreclosure process. However, Zalewski must show how the mistake prejudiced her ability to reclaim her home.
